name: Teaching at the Right Level Africa
summary: Helps African governments group primary pupils by learning level for daily reading and maths sessions (the Teaching at the Right Level approach from Pratham and J-PAL).

spending.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/922014591 (Empower Learning Africa USA Inc, aka TaRL Africa, Form 990 for 2025, Part IX line 25 column B: program service expenses 1,137,527 of 1,183,871 total. The only public accounts: the Kenyan entity that runs the country programmes publishes none. This is only part of the organisation's money: TaRL Africa gave The Life You Can Save 3.6 million dollars of 2024 spending in its three core countries, and The Life You Can Save states an unaudited budget of 12.1 million for FY 2025/26.)

lines.label: Support to governments' Teaching at the Right Level programmes
lines.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/922014591 (Form 990 for 2025, Part III: financial, advisory, logistical and programme support to TaRL Africa's programmes, 7,828 + 26,393 + 1,103,306; one programme, so one line)
